## Description
Clear description of the work to be completed.

## Priority
- [ ] **High (P1)** - Blocking other work, critical path
- [ ] **Medium (P2)** - Important, scheduled for sprint
- [ ] **Low (P3)** - Backlog, nice-to-do

## Scope
- **Component:** [Frontend / Backend / API / DevOps / Documentation / Infra]
- **Category:** [Refactoring / Documentation / Maintenance / Ops / Testing]
- **Effort Estimate:** [XS / S / M / L / XL]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Dependencies
- Depends on: [link to related issues/PRs]
- Blocks: [what work depends on this]

## Owner Assignment
@mention a team member or domain owner
